subject: Pilot kickoff: solution fit recap + 30-day onboarding path (BlueOak Analytics)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueoakanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@blueoakanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff: solution fit recap + 30-day onboarding path (BlueOak Analytics)

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned ahead of a short pilot (30-day):

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Query latency spikes for batch inference during morning windows (~95th percentile > 2.5s).
- High per-token cost on multi-tenant endpoints leads to throttled experiments.
- Need deterministic outputs for reranking pipeline to measure ROI across models.

Pilot goal (30 days):
1) Reduce 95th percentile serving latency to <1.2s for the most common request shape (avg prompt length ~120 tokens).
2) Cut per-token inference cost for the reranker by >=25% via batching + KV prefix caching.
3) Provide an eval suite (50 prompt templates + golden labels) and baseline quality comparison vs your current service.

Proposed scope (what Redwood will deliver):
- Dedicated pilot cluster (shared capacity window) with optimized quantized model variant.
- Prompt/eval harness + initial 50-template prompt set (we will ship an initial draft).
- Access checklist and brief runbook for SSO + data ingress (see attached stub).
- Weekly syncs (Tuesdays, 30 min) + one mid-pilot checkpoint at day 14.

Owners (proposed):
- BlueOak: Liam (Engineering lead) — data & infra access, eval labeling; Priya (Product) — success criteria sign-off.
- Redwood: Camila (AE) — pilot coordination; Karthik (Solutions Eng) — technical onboarding & SSO; Marissa (Customer Success) — eval design and measurements.

Immediate asks / next steps (can we confirm by EOD Friday?):
1) Confirm the two test workloads (reranker + chat assistant) we discussed.
2) Grant a read-only S3 bucket for historical prompt/label samples and a staging API key (scope-limited).
3) One-week availability window for a 60-min technical kickoff with Karthik and infra owners (we proposed Mon 10/12 or Tue 10/13).

Attachments: BOA_poc_scope_and_success_metrics.xlsx (pilot charter draft)

I attached a short scope draft + success metric table. If this summary looks correct I will: (a) lock the charter and share final prompt/eval templates, (b) send an access checklist for your infra team, and (c) put the kickoff calendar invite on both schedules.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0184
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueoakanalytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@blueoakanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: solution fit recap + 30-day onboarding path (BlueOak Analytics)

Thanks Camila — solid recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Workloads: Confirmed — reranker (high qps burst in mornings) and conversational assistant (lower qps, longer context).
- Data access: We can provision a read-only S3 bucket with ~7 days of historical prompts + labels. Will that be sufficient for your eval harness?
- Timeline: Tue 10/13 works best for our infra lead (we prefer late morning, 11:00–12:00 PT).

Questions: 
1) Can Redwood support a canary rollout to a single AZ first (we need to limit blast radius while validating latency changes)?
2) For the eval baseline, do you need full user PII redaction on samples or are hashed identifiers OK? Our legal prefers redaction.

I copied Priya — she'll confirm access timelines and internal stakeholders. We should be able to confirm the two items you asked about by Friday.

—
Liam O'Connor
Head of Engineering, BlueOak Analytics
liam.oconnor@blueoakanalytics.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueoakanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@blueoakanalytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: solution fit recap + 30-day onboarding path (BlueOak Analytics)

Liam — great, thanks. Quick answers inline and a couple of follow-ups for our teams.

> Can Redwood support a canary rollout to a single AZ first?
Yes — Redwood's routing supports policy-based canaries by AZ. Karthik will own the canary config and will propose the fallback policy so you can limit blast radius.

> PII redaction vs hashed identifiers?
Redaction is preferred for the eval harness. Hashed IDs can be used for correlation but we'll treat any identifier as sensitive. We'll ship a simple redaction script you can run prior to S3 upload.

Follow-ups for BlueOak (action items):
- Provide a short list (1–2) of sample endpoints + expected peak QPS for the reranker.
- Share the S3 location and an IAM read-only role (or temporary credentials) — we can accept temp creds.
- Confirm kickoff slot: Tue 2026-10-13 11:00 PT — we'll send an invite.

Internal note to Karthik & Marissa:
- Karthik: please prepare a canary rollout doc with rollback thresholds (latency & error rates) and SSO checklist (OIDC preferred).
- Marissa: can you draft a 50-template eval prompt set skeleton and baseline metrics table (precision@k; latency percentiles) by Monday EOD?

I've attached the working charter (BOA_poc_scope_and_success_metrics.xlsx). If OK I'll convert to the HubSpot attachment and attach the kickoff invite once the time is locked.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite and the access checklist.

—
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@blueoakanalytics.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@blueoakanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: solution fit recap + 30-day onboarding path (BlueOak Analytics)

Folks — looping in a brief technical checklist and the immediate deliverables from Redwood's side so BlueOak knows what to expect at kickoff.

Redwood deliverables before kickoff: 
- Canary plan + rollback thresholds (latency 95th > +0.6s relative to baseline OR error rate > 1.5%) — draft attached in the shared folder.
- Redaction script (Python) + sample runbook for S3 ingestion.
- Prompt/eval skeleton (Marissa will own completion).
- Staging API key scoped to reranker + assistant (rate-limited).

BlueOak deliverables before kickoff: 
- S3 read-only access (temp creds or IAM role) + two sample endpoints with peak qps numbers.
- Contact for infra (name/email) for the 60-min technical session.
- Confirmation on PII policy (redaction is fine).

Operational notes: 
- We'll use Tuesday 2026-10-13 11:00 PT for the kickoff. Invite to follow.
- Marissa: please create the eval deck (50 templates + baseline measurement table) by Monday so we can review on the kickoff call.

If BlueOak confirms the S3 details, we'll provision a short-lived staging key and push the first quantized model variant into the dedicated pilot cluster for the canary test.

—
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
